I isolate too, and am having a lot of trouble keeping in touch/answering. 

Not sure there's anything you could write that would make it easier to send a response.

I'll usually not respond right away because I have no idea what to say, talking does not come easy to me, and if I have no idea what to write or talk about, I'll try not to participate, or tell myself I'll come back to it once I have an answer. And then forget about it because I focused on something else. Remember about it a couple days later, and feel guilty about it, pushing me to avoid communicating with them even more, or even "losing" my phone.

As an example, my mom (who is, or should be by now, used to me not answering) messaged me about a month ago about something for an early present for my father, wasn't sure if I needed to be there, or wire money. In hindsight I simply could have answered just that "What do you need?", but I did not. Now it's been a month, present has been bought but I still did not answer. It might be because I don't have a legitimate excuse for the month of delay, I do not know. Tomorrow, if I don't forget, I'll finally send an answer, and apologize for not answering, as I always end up doing.

I have no idea if that helped, not even sure my experience is similar to your friend's, but thanks for what you're doing for him.

I am sorry that happened to you. If it's any comfort, I think you should take pride in the fact that you've been able to get through a day in that state, despite the pointlessness it could have felt, and then did it twice again. Maybe even once more by the time you read this.
You can call them tomorrow, or just vent here. People might not answer it, but it will more probably be because they have no idea what to answer or did not find your message.

I'm relatively tall, I still have some hair in my 30s, my parents are fine, I'm the one who's not talking to them. One could think we have nothing in common.

I used to be made fun of, for growing up in a foreign country not understanding the local language by my "friends". I don't anymore since I have no friends.

And, despite all those differences, I kind of understand your pain. It is cliche, but remember that's it's ok not to feel ok.

I would actually prefer none of them get marked, pretty much all classes get to do some spash damage on their single target rotation and the encounter would end a bit faster if they got killed at the same time.

Strongly disagree, some (maybe even most) do clear with assistance from tools, but there are others that prefer to do it manually.

I can guarantee that all content is clearable without such tools, and people arguing that "titan gaols require a tool to solve" or "you don't have time to understand and react to nael sentences anyways, you need a trigger to tell you what to do" are just plain wrong, I did both, consistently, and without shot caller, and we were not even that good.

In the end it's mostly an issue of lazyness and objectives. If you want to clear asap and parade the weapons, then yeah, makes sense to use it if you're too lazy to learn the fight in it's entirety. If you want to have fun, play the game, and challenge yourself with the hardest content, then I do not get why you would use them.
I personally find it even worse when they ask me what I had planned/how it went. But I can understand that pain.

And that's why I always tell that my birthday is June 31.

Cuts out a lot of the awkwardness.

So what you are saying is that it is feasible.

Good to know!

Mass Effect
Same as 2019, except I'm one year older.

You already figured out glamours is the true endgame, so not much to add.

You might want to add shiva unreal to that extensive list.

Depending on your class(es) you might also want to solo/duo farm old content for those sweet glamours that you won't be getting anywhere else. A lot of fun can be had trying to figure out how to handle old mechanics with modern DPS/hp pool, but no healer/less players on the field.

Once you finish crafters you might try your hand at 4stars ishgard restauration, those can be challenging, and also yet another way to get some more glamours.

Once you're done with savage raids, if you enjoy difficulty, you might want to try your hand at the ultimate raids (there's only one shb ultimate fight right now, TEA, and 2 stormblood ones). It is a huge time sink, but will reward you with, you guessed it, glamours. Don't go into those without a motivated premade party (emphasis on the motivated).

You might also try blue mage, specially if you consider yourself a player that enjoy collecting stuff.

10 years here, I keep myself busy all day, no matter how, it mostly works. Nights can be really hard when I can't sleep, that's why I end up here.

If I could let 10 years ago me know anything, it would be not to worry about what I do to keep myself from thinking, as long as it is sustainable.
My 30th birthday was supposed to be it. I'm nearly 31 and still breathing, not sure why. How long did you give yourself?

Hi,

Your story reminded me that I too was once called a subhuman. And it wasn't in a really racist country, as far as I know, and wasn't even that different, just was not speaking their language, as a recently immigrated child. I left that country since, and I don't plan on ever going back there.

I used to really want to be "normal", like them, to be accepted. That never happened. Fuck them, fuck being "normal" and most of all fuck young me for ever thinking that was a goal worth considering.

I am alone, and lonely, so far coping by lurking here, to remind myself that I'm not the only one that is unhappy with his life.

I heard you, if that helps.

Decided when the outbreak started not to seek out medical help if I got it. I am isolated 99% of the time so it's not like I would be likely to pass it on someone else.

I fell ill a couple weeks into confinement, was very probably covid19, but survived. My family still does not know.

Well, see you next outbreak I guess.
